title: The name check refuses ordinary kb text on a CI shell runner or a Windows container account
goal: The account and host names CI gives every machine (gitlab-runner on a shell executor, ContainerAdministrator and ContainerUser in Windows containers, a Kubernetes pod's random 5-character suffix) give no name piece, so backlog.py check and the push gate never refuse kb text such as a gitlab-runner path there. Found by the SP-2agxqrrv review.

run: import sys, subprocess, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import backlog as b; sys.exit(0 if not b.name_pieces('gitlab-runner') and not b.name_pieces('ContainerAdministrator') else 1)
